findings.question: q-text-types-speeches-0015
findings.quote: Which statement best respects the speech''s mixed purpose?
findings.problem: The stem announces that the purpose is mixed. Only the keyed choice lists several purposes; every distractor says the speech is purely one type. A student can select the key without reading the speech.
findings.fix: Ask "Which statement best describes the speech's purpose?" and give alternatives that each combine plausible purposes.
